Label: concept word frame
Description: A lexicon entry, new in v0.0.2 (7,537 entries): one English word or phrase (aura:word) for one concept, tagged noun or verb (aura:part-of-speech). About 5,650 noun entries cover about 3,400 concepts and about 1,900 verb entries cover about 1,200 process concepts. Verb entries also record which aura relation the verb's grammatical subject and object fill (e.g. 'convert': subject agent, object raw-material) and the prepositions that introduce other roles. The entry IRIs (aura:Concept-Word-Frame102883) are opaque.

Label: annotation property
Description: Declared aura annotation property (5: concept2words, description, in-concept, prototype-node, user-description).

Label: OWL class
Description: Every biology concept (about 6,300 named, plus about 21,000 aura:ID-N prototype-node markers and many anonymous class expressions) is an owl:Class. KB Bio 101 is an ontology: concepts are classes, not instances.

Label: datatype property
Description: Declared aura property with literal values (5: atomic-symbol, called, node-id, the-cardinal-value, value).

Label: functional property
Description: aura relation that takes at most one value (127).

Label: named individual
Description: The only individuals in the graph (634): qualitative constants such as colours, shapes and directions, and units of measurement, each typed with its *-Constant or UoM-* class.

Label: object property
Description: Declared aura relation between concepts (353).

Label: ontology
Description: The ontology header node, which carries the licence notice.

Label: OWL restriction
Description: Anonymous class expression (about 80,700) that carries a concept's relation axioms: owl:onProperty names the aura relation and owl:someValuesFrom, owl:hasValue or owl:onClass plus a cardinality gives the filler.

Label: transitive property
Description: Transitive aura relation (17).

Label: grammatical object
Description: For a verb lexicon entry, the aura relation that the verb's grammatical object fills, e.g. aura:raw-material for "convert" (378 entries). The object is an aura property, not a concept.

Label: grammatical object
Description: For a verb lexicon entry, the aura relation that the verb's grammatical object fills, e.g. aura:raw-material for "convert" (378 entries). The object is an aura property, not a concept.

Label: grammatical subject
Description: For a verb lexicon entry, the aura relation that the verb's grammatical subject fills, e.g. aura:agent for "convert" (491 entries). The object is an aura property, not a concept.

Label: grammatical subject
Description: For a verb lexicon entry, the aura relation that the verb's grammatical subject fills, e.g. aura:agent for "convert" (491 entries). The object is an aura property, not a concept.

Label: implied participant
Description: For a verb lexicon entry, an aura relation that the verb implies without naming it, e.g. aura:instrument (75 entries). The object is an aura property, not a concept.

Label: part of speech
Description: Part of speech of a lexicon entry: "n" (noun, about 5,650) or "v" (verb, about 1,900).

Label: preposition
Description: For a verb lexicon entry, how a preposition introduces one of the event's roles. Each value is a blank-node RDF list: rdf:first is the aura relation and the next member is the preposition string, e.g. (aura:result "to") for "convert", (aura:raw-material "using") for "synthesize". Read it with ?f aura:preposition ?l . ?l rdf:first ?role ; rdf:rest/rdf:first ?prep (662 values).

Label: primary nominalization for
Description: Links a verb lexicon entry to the process concept that names its action as a noun (1,225 entries), e.g. the verb "convert" and the process Phosphorylation.

Label: primary noun for
Description: Links a noun lexicon entry to the concept for which it is the preferred noun (2,486 entries). Not every concept has one.

Label: primary verb for
Description: Links a verb lexicon entry to the process concept for which it is the preferred verb (1,228 entries), e.g. "convert" for Phosphorylation.

Label: synonym for
Description: Links a lexicon entry to the concept its word names (on 7,399 of the 7,537 entries). Gives each concept its alternative names, e.g. Mitochondrion: "mitochondrion", "mitochondria". A word can name several concepts ("convert" is a verb for Photosynthesis, Phosphorylation and Decarboxylation), so check the concept's class before using a word as a match key.

Label: word
Description: The word or phrase of a lexicon entry, e.g. "mitochondria", "photosynthesize", "perform cellular respiration". Spellings mix spaces, hyphens and underscores ("stand_up", "aerobic-respiration"), so normalise them before matching. One per entry.

Label: description
Description: Longer definition of a concept or relation, often quoting the source text (e.g. Alberts, Essential Cell Biology). Present on about 160 concepts; some values have their spaces stripped.

Label: in concept
Description: Links an aura:ID-N node-marker class to the concept in which that node was introduced (about 21,000 markers).

Label: prototype node
Description: The original AURA prototype-node identifier (a string such as "_Energy-Transformation-by-Organism33214") of an aura:ID-N marker class.

Label: user description
Description: Short textbook-style definition of a concept, written by the KB's biologist encoders. Present on about 5,700 concepts; the best source of a human-readable definition.

Label: subclass of
Description: Links a concept to its necessary conditions. About 24,700 triples point straight at a named parent, but most biology concepts point to an anonymous owl:Class whose owl:intersectionOf list holds the named parent(s) and nested owl:Restriction blocks. Reach named parents with rdfs:subClassOf/(owl:intersectionOf/rdf:rest*/rdf:first)* and FILTER(isIRI(?parent)). 197 axioms run the other way, from an anonymous class to a named concept: these are sufficient conditions ('triggers'), meaning anything matching the description is an instance of that concept.

Label: disjoint with
Description: States that two named concepts share no instances, e.g. Mitochondrion is disjoint with Nucleus, Plastid and Vesicle.

Label: intersection of
Description: Links an anonymous owl:Class to an RDF list (rdf:first/rdf:rest) of the classes and restrictions it conjoins. This is how each concept bundles its named parents with its relation axioms; the lists nest several levels deep.

Label: union of
Description: Links an anonymous owl:Class to an RDF list of alternative classes. Rare: 14 uses.

Label: atomic mass
Description: Atomic mass is the sum of the masses of the protons, neutrons and electrons in a specific isotope of an atom, measured in daltons. Because the mass of an electron is very small and does not contribute much to the overall mass of an atom, the atomic mass number is a close approximation of the actual mass of an atom. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: atomic number
Description: The number of protons in a nucleus. It determines the chemical properties of an element. Functional. Used only inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 198 owl:Restrictions; never asserted as a direct triple.

Description: Inverse of atomic-number: The number of protons in a nucleus. It determines the chemical properties of an element. Used only inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 3 owl:Restrictions; never asserted as a direct triple.

Label: atomic symbol

Label: atomic weight
Description: The mass of a neutral atom of a nuclide. The atomic weight of an atom is the weight of the atom based on a scale where 12C = 12. The atomic weight of an element is the weighted average of each isotope. Functional. Used only inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 130 owl:Restrictions; never asserted as a direct triple.
